items.title: Micron, Accenture, Google, IBM, Fair Isaac, Synopsys, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks fell Thursday as bond yields continued to rise after notching their largest quarterly gain since 1994.  Micron dropped 1.9% after the company posted a stellar fiscal fourth-quarter earnings report.

items.title: IBM Is Betting AI’s Next Big Market Won’t Live in the Cloud
items.summary: IBM (NYSE:IBM) confirmed Thursday that it is making its AI software-development platform available for on-premises, private-cloud, sovereign-cloud and even air-gapped environments. IBM Bob, the company’s agentic software-development platform, can now run inside customer-controlled infrastructure. That means sensitive source code, application context and development artifacts can remain within an enterprise’s own environment rather than being sent to an external AI service. items.title: Accenture Stock Is Heading for Its Best Day Ever. AI Isn’t the Threat Everyone Thought.
items.summary: Accenture stock jumps after the company posts stronger-than-expected earnings, brushing off AI disruption concerns.

items.title: Accenture Soars 23% as Record Bookings Dispel AI Demand Fears; Infosys Jumps 8%, IBM Climbs 5%
items.summary: Accenture just answered the question that has haunted consulting stocks all year, and the market is repricing the entire sector in real time. Whether the relief lasts depends on a risk that one record quarter cannot put to rest.

items.title: Strength in Accenture’s Consulting Business Gives IBM Stock a Much-Needed Boost
items.summary: IBM stock rebounds from a five-day slump after Accenture’s solid earnings signal resilience in tech consulting amid AI disruption fears.

items.title: Hedera Jumped 27% on an IBM Cloud Deal and Gave Back 16% the Next Day. HBAR vs XRP: Which Enterprise Coin Is the Better Buy?
items.summary: IBM just handed Hedera a 27% surge and the market gave most of it back within 24 hours, raising a pointed question about whether enterprise partnerships actually move the needle for either HBAR or its longtime rival XRP.

items.title: IBM Jumps 5% as Bob Coding Agent Gains Self-Hosted Deployment; Salesforce Rises 3%, Palantir Inches Higher
items.summary: IBM stock surged far ahead of the broader software sector after quietly extending its Bob coding agent into a corner of the market most AI platforms cannot reach. Whether the move signals a lasting repricing or a one-day pop depends on details IBM has not yet disclosed.

items.title: Was There Any Sign Palantir Stock Would Run?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) stock returned 60.3% in the three months from June 30 to September 29, 2026. A $10,000 holding at the start of that window was worth about $16,030 at the end. The run came from faster sales growth, led by the U.S. business, and Palantir reports that growth every quarter. Could you have seen that growth coming before June 30.
